name: A2A directory listing state
principle: Where the estate's A2A agent is listed, and where it is not. Every row is a probe of the DIRECTORY, never of our own filesystem. This file mirrors mcp-directories.json deliberately: that file was wrong six times in one day, and every one of those errors came from answering 'do we hold a note saying we are listed' instead of asking the directory. UNKNOWN is a permitted state and is not NOT_LISTED.
surface_note: Each row names the surface its state came from. `ours` is never valid evidence about a third party. `rendered` is NECESSARY where a directory has no API and NOT SUFFICIENT where one exists — a rendered search echoes the query back, which produced both a false LISTED and a false NOT_LISTED in the MCP census on 2026-09-05. `api` and `sitemap` are authoritative.

our_agent.note: Card shape is A2A v1.0.1: the AgentCard carries NO top-level url or protocolVersion — both are REQUIRED fields of AgentInterface instead, and ours carries all three (url, protocolBinding, protocolVersion). Verified against specification/a2a.proto at tag v1.0.1, not against a remembered field list.

directories.name: A2A Registry
directories.evidence: GET /api/agents returns 50 agents; zero match csoai or councilof. Registration is a single unauthenticated POST of a public well-known URI — no account, no key, no payment. Not submitted: the card names https://councilof.ai/api/a2a and that door is 404 (GET) / 405 (POST) during the B41 outage, and their worker health-checks every 30 minutes. A listing whose door does not resolve is worse than no listing.

submission.validated_how: Their backend/app/validators.py was read and its strict rule set run against our live card: required = name, description, url, version, capabilities, defaultInputModes, defaultOutputModes, skills, with url and protocolVersion lifted from supportedInterfaces[0] by their own v1.0 compatibility path. Zero defects. A test in this repo re-runs those rules on every commit.

directories.name: a2aprotocol.net
directories.evidence: No agent index surface exists to be listed in: /sitemap.xml 404, /sitemap_index.xml 404, /agents 404, /directory 404, /api/agents 404. It is a protocol content site. Its robots.txt opens with a terms-of-access condition.
directories.probe:
for p in /sitemap.xml /agents /directory /api/agents; do curl -sL -o /dev/null -w "$p %{http_code}
" https://www.a2aprotocol.net$p; done

directories.name: agentcards.org
directories.evidence: Parked domain offered for sale. Every path including /sitemap.xml returns HTTP 200 with the title 'For Sale Domain: agentcards.org'. A 200 here is a parking page, not a directory — this row exists so the name is never re-probed and read as live.

totals.note: Counts are DERIVED from GET https://a2aregistry.org/api/agents at as_of. They are not typed.

what_this_does_not_establish: No directory named here endorses the Council of AI.
NOT_LISTED means no listing was found at as_of, not that a submission was refused. For a2aregistry no submission has been made.
Three candidate directories were probed. This is not a proof that no other A2A directory exists.
That every listed agent in a2aregistry is on A2A 0.3 is a fact about that registry at as_of, not a judgement about 0.3 or about them.

known_defects.detail: a2aregistry's schemas/registry-agent.schema.json $refs a2a-official.schema.json#/definitions/AgentCard. That file is not in the repository tree, so the published schema cannot be resolved by a stranger. Their running backend validates in Python instead and is unaffected.

known_defects: 2026-09-05: this lane opened by reporting our own card as defective — 'protocolVersion: null, url: null, the A2A spec's required fields'. That was read off A2A v0.3.0's JSON schema, which does require both at the top level. In v1.0.1 neither field exists on AgentCard: both moved into AgentInterface, and our card carries them there. The card was conformant the whole time. Check the version of the spec you are holding before calling an artifact broken.

2026-09-05: a2aregistry.org/docs still describes a 'Git-as-database model on GitHub' and the repository has an empty agents/ tree; registration has since moved to a POST against a backend with SQL migrations. The documented mechanism and the working mechanism had diverged — the README, not the docs page, carried the live one.

2026-09-05: /submit was first fetched WITHOUT -L and returned a 169-byte '301 Moved Permanently' body, from which a grep for github links found nothing. Absence measured through an unfollowed redirect is not absence.
